Optional Stuff
You can add your boss to the "Book of Familiar Faces" if you want


The Director of the Library, Angela

Angela is a difficult boss with 3 phases, the first introduces you to the stagger gimmick, the second enhances her basic attack, and the third makes her a powerhouse.

Gimmick - Stagger
Angela has a separate HP value called Stagger Resist. (STG) 
When STG hits 0, Angela gets Staggered and cannot take her next 2 actions and her DEF is reduced by -50%.
STG ignores ATK and DEF parameters.

Passive - Knowledge
Gain a stack of The Knowing every turn.
The Knowing - All stats +5% for each stack, up to 20 stacks. Dispels if Angela is Staggered.
When she is in Phase 3, All stats +10% for each stack, up to 10 stacks.

Basic Attack
Angela does one of the three attack types. Blunt, Pierce, and Slash.
Blunt deals the lowest, but if enhanced, it also heals her.
Pierce is the middle of the three, if enhanced, it also decreases the team's DEF.
Slash does the most damage, if enhanced, additionally add 1 Light.
If she is in Phase 3, she does 2 attacks instead.
Add 1 Light

Skill - Book of Familiar Faces
Angela uses a Book to summon a familiar boss, anything can happen!
Cost 3 Light

Infringio Moveset

Basic Attack
Infringio stomps the Boss 3 times. Classic Mario!
Adds 15 POW

Enhanced Basic Attack
Infringio stomps 7 times instead and does a pose in the end!
(Requires the "Challenge of the Day" buff)

Skill - "Defeat the Boss!"
Infringio snaps his fingers and a contestant from his show appears to aid him.
Each contestant performs a unique Skill at the end of the Team's turns.

Mario - Hammer Suit - Throws 2 Hammers that deal heavy damage.
Luigi - Cape Feather - Flies around and hits the boss in all directions.
Toad - Super Mushroom - Heals the team.
Toadette - Double Cherry - Grants the Team 2x attack for 1 turn.
Yoshi - Egg Toss - Throws an egg, and has a low chance of inflicting stun.
Gweenie - Competitive Spirit - Grants the Team 1.25x attack for 3 turns.

Cost 15 POW

Enhanced Skill - "Overcome the Odds!"
It behaves like Skill, but the contestant's Skill is enhanced.

Mario+ - Fire Flower - Throws a barrage of fireballs that burn the boss.
Luigi+ - Ice Flower - Throws an iceball that freezes the boss.
Toad+ - 1-UP Mushroom - Same as Normal, but Heals more and scales with ATK.
Toadette+ - Super Star - Grant Invincibility to Infringio for 1 attack
Yoshi+ - Egg Roll - Curls into an Egg and Rolls over the Boss, stunning them.
Gweenie+ - Overwhelming Enthusiasm -  Attacks and grants the Team 1.5x attack for 3 turns.

Cost 0 POW (Requires the "Challenge of the Day" buff)

Ultimate - "Today's Challenge!"
Infringio handwaves the situation to the contestants as the Challenge!
Gain the buff "Challenge of the Day", enhancing his attacks and the cost of Skill to 0. Also triggers Enhanced Skill once.
Infringio also gets Extra HP. Extra HP is separate from HP. "Challenge of the Day" dispels if Infringio's Extra HP is gone.
Cost 150 POW
